title.narrative: Empowering Students in STEM: 3D Art Exploration

description.narrative: Empowering Students in STEM: 3D Art Exploration aims to empower students in Aruba to develop their creative potential and acquire technical skills through immersive workshops focused on 3D design and printing. The project aims to address the needs of all students in STEM by promoting inclusivity and reducing the gender gap. This innovative initiative fosters creativity and technical skills in Aruban boys and girls aged 8-14. This 3-month program, comprising 10 workshops (organized for two cohorts), introduces participants to 3D digital design, printing, and artistic expression. A parallel 10-week course for educators enhances classroom 3D printing integration into the day-to-day curriculum. Seeking support, the program aspires to inspire, educate, and showcase the talents of young artists, envisioning a lasting impact on their personal and professional growth.
